title: Apply Alfa LLM segmentation to residio HMM and generate artifacts

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Starting residio HMM with Alfa-style LLM segmentation (span_markup + LLM fallback) and graphviz artifacts. Using extraction snapshot pipeline:a92c0e...

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Blocked: Alfa-style HMM segmentation uses OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini). Run fails because OPENAI_API_KEY is not set (message: configure OPENAI_API_KEY or openai.api_key in ~/.biblicus/config.yml). Installed dspy dependency successfully. Once key is set, rerun markov analysis with configurations/analysis/residio-markov-alfa.yml.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Switching to conversation-phase segmentation (span_markup) + LLM labeling for noun-phrase+quote state names. New config: configurations/analysis/residio-markov-conversation.yml. Running sample (1 doc) first for preview, then full run.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Stopped slow span_markup run. Switching to faster LLM JSON segmentation for high-level phases (still labels each phase with noun-phrase + exemplar quote). Updated configurations/analysis/residio-markov-conversation.yml accordingly and will rerun sample + full.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Progress: updated configurations/analysis/residio-markov-conversation.yml to use LLM JSON segmentation (verbatim text spans) + LLM noun-phrase+quote labels. Sample run completed with larger segments and llm_label in observations.jsonl. Next: run full analysis with extraction snapshot pipeline:a92c0e..., then generate GraphViz PNG artifact from transitions.dot.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Started full markov run using updated LLM segmentation config. Snapshot: 1e802bbcad8c2550800adc5f0cdfec8d5fb5c98c63d1aefc1ed0571dc18ea1d5 (extraction pipeline:a92c0e...). Will generate transitions.png after completion.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Segmentation complete: 230/230 docs, 6926 segments. Labeling 6466 segments with 4 workers now.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Run complete: snapshot 1e802bbcad8c2550800adc5f0cdfec8d5fb5c98c63d1aefc1ed0571dc18ea1d5. Generated GraphViz PNG at corpora/residio-google-drive/analysis/markov/1e802.../transitions.png. Next: surface exemplar outputs and finalize artifacts.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Topic modeling run started with configurations/analysis/residio-topic.yml after installing spaCy + en_core_web_sm. Progress: entity removal 50/231 docs (rate ~4.3/s).

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Topic modeling complete: snapshot c5fd8719c911882db2e6fa5df602b00fb81a9d44a3d7450c80e9eca665b5cce4. Artifacts in corpora/residio-google-drive/analysis/topic-modeling/c5fd... (output.json, entity_removal.jsonl). output.json includes topics with exemplar documents.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Note: Markov fit warns about many parameters vs data (n_states=10, segments=6926). If we want a more stable HMM, consider reducing n_states or tfidf max_features in a follow-up.
